overview: Based on the published agenda, the Village of Kronenwetter Board was scheduled to meet on August 10, 2026 to consider staff reports on police, fire, and financial matters, as well as new business including an Oak Wilt Ordinance and a resolution establishing a temporary moratorium on new data center development applications. The meeting was set to address zoning and development policy matters referred to planning committees for further study.

agenda.item: Revaluation Update Report from Village Assessor
Finance Director Report – Preliminary Equalized Valuation & TID Increments
Resolution 2026-011 Establishing a Temporary Moratorium on New Data Center Development Applications and Referring the Matter to the Planning and Utility Committees for Further Study (CLIPP)

discussions.body: The board was scheduled to discuss and take possible action on an Oak Wilt Ordinance, a measure related to environmental or forestry management within the village.

discussions.item: Resolution 2026-011 Temporary Moratorium on New Data Center Development
discussions.body: The board was set to consider Resolution 2026-011, which was scheduled to establish a temporary moratorium on new data center development applications while referring the matter to the Planning and Utility Committees for further study and analysis.

discussions.item: Finance Director Report – Preliminary Equalized Valuation & TID Increments
discussions.body: The Finance Director was scheduled to present a report on preliminary equalized valuation and Tax Increment District (TID) increments for the village's review and consideration.

publicComment: Public comment was indicated on the agenda, scheduled for up to 15 minutes total with a three-minute time period per person, subject to extension at the Chief Presiding Officer's discretion.
actionItems: Scheduled to vote on approval of July 27, 2026 Village Board Meeting Minutes
Expected to consider and take action on the Oak Wilt Ordinance
Scheduled to vote on Resolution 2026-011 establishing a temporary moratorium on new data center development applications
title: Village Board Meeting - 2026-08-10
